payload.note: regime -> violation-type -> fine formula/cap, grounded in real public enforcement notices, each carrying its own finality status; a published frequency per violation type; and per-control weights, each carrying its basis. Feeds the platform FAIR engine's loss-magnitude and loss-event-frequency inputs directly.
payload.changelog: v4 (eco-system ticket 79 items 1, 3 and 5, with review fixes F1, F2, F4 and F5): (a) every real example carries `source`, `status`, `final_as_of` and a `litigation` note, and only a figure whose status is `final` or `imposed-appeal-unchecked` prices -- the publisher's rule is the FINAL COLLECTED FIGURE, not the notice figure (rule.yaml). `source` is REQUIRED (F1): before it was, an invented GBP 5,000,000 with a status and no source moved uk-gdpr/lower-tier's priced mode from GBP 92,000 to GBP 2,546,000 and the feed check said PASS. Doorstep Dispensaree's GBP 275,000 notice becomes the GBP 92,000 the FIRST-TIER TRIBUNAL set in 2021 and the Court of Appeal confirmed in 2024, cited to this estate's own sourced record and dated to the YEAR, which is the precision that record supports (F2); the notice figure is kept as `notice_gbp`, and a `notice_gbp` below its own `fine_gbp` is refused (F5). Clearview AI's GBP 7,552,800 was set aside, reinstated on jurisdiction and remitted, and has never been collected: it does not price. Starling Bank's FCA final notice of 2024-09-27 is added as the one example whose finality a run of this estate established (eco-system ticket 94). Every other example is `imposed-appeal-unchecked` under ONE rule (F4): a regulator's own concluding instrument, whichever regulator issued it, with no adverse litigation known here and no register read for it. (b) every violation type publishes `frequency` -- a lo<=mode<=hi band and a `basis` carrying a kind, a dated `as_of`, a `denominator` and a `could_not_look`. The floor is 0, so a loss-free year is possible; the flat (1, 2, 4) the converter used to default to made one impossible. (c) every control weight carries the same `basis` shape. A converter that meets a frequency or a weight with no basis refuses (ADR-0020). payload_schema change, so a major (ADR-0019).

real_examples_gbp.litigation: an ICO monetary penalty notice under DPA 2018 s155 is the penalty IMPOSED, not a notice of intent: the GBP 183,390,000 notice of intent of 2019 was reduced to this figure before it was issued.
